name: concurrent deposits preserve every inherited operation
input: eight threads deposit 100 into one delayed account
test:
import threading
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

account = SynchronizedBankAccount(0, operation_delay=0.002)
gate = threading.Barrier(8)

def deposit_worker(_):
    gate.wait()
    account.deposit(100)

with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
    list(pool.map(deposit_worker, range(8)))

assert isinstance(account, BankAccount)
assert account.get_balance() == 800
assert account.base_deposit_calls == 8

name: the balance check and inherited withdrawal are one critical section
input: six simultaneous withdrawals of 100 from a balance of 100
test:
import threading
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

account = SynchronizedBankAccount(100, operation_delay=0.002)
gate = threading.Barrier(6)

def withdraw_worker(_):
    gate.wait()
    try:
        account.withdraw(100)
        return True
    except InsufficientFunds:
        return False

with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
    outcomes = list(pool.map(withdraw_worker, range(6)))

assert outcomes.count(True) == 1
assert outcomes.count(False) == 5
assert account.get_balance() == 0
assert account.base_withdraw_calls == 1

name: wrapper preserves parent validation and delegation
input: invalid amounts plus one valid deposit and withdrawal
test:
account = SynchronizedBankAccount(10)
for call in (lambda: account.deposit(0), lambda: account.withdraw(-1)):
    try:
        call()
        raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
    except ValueError:
        pass
account.deposit(7)
account.withdraw(4)
assert account.get_balance() == 13
assert account.base_deposit_calls == 1
assert account.base_withdraw_calls == 1
